description.zh: 《Brass: Birmingham》的流程定义——一局游戏从 Setup 到终局计分的完整流程。与 concepts.json 配合：concepts.json 定义「有什么」（对象、行动、条件），本文档定义「按什么顺序进行」（设置、运河时代、铁路时代、终局计分）。核心结构：设置（版图/市场/商人/抽牌堆/角色板块随机顺序/每玩家 £17+8 张手牌+1 张面朝下弃牌）→ 运河时代（首回合每玩家仅 1 个行动；此后主回合循环直到抽牌堆空且所有手牌为空——每回合末确定下回合顺序并收收入，运河最终回合不收收入；随后运河计分＋时代转换）→ 铁路时代（同一回合结构，每回合收收入；铁路计分后直接进入终局计分——MD 的「End of Rail Era」一节重复了运河转换步骤，系规则书勘误）→ 终局计分（钱每 £4 得 1 分上限 15、收入等级 ±分、2 级及以上板块二次计分，按<most_vp_wins>判胜）。两时代共用同一回合定义（<round>，运河时代定义、铁路时代引用）。
description.en: The flow definition for Brass: Birmingham — the complete sequence of a game from setup to final scoring. Complements concepts.json: concepts.json defines 'what exists' (objects, actions, conditions); this document defines 'in what order it happens' (setup, the Canal Era, the Rail Era, final scoring). Core structure: setup (board/markets/merchants/draw deck/random character-tile order/£17 + 8 cards + 1 face-down discard per player) → the Canal Era (opening round with only 1 action per player; then main rounds repeating until the draw deck is exhausted and every hand is empty — each round ends with turn-order determination and income, except the Canal Era's final round which skips income; then Canal scoring and the era transition) → the Rail Era (the same round structure with income every round; after Rail scoring the game goes straight to final scoring — the MD's 'End of Rail Era' section duplicates the Canal transition steps, a rulebook erratum) → final scoring (money at 1 VP per £4, max 15; income-level ±VPs; Level 2+ tiles score a second time; adjudicated by <most_vp_wins>). Both eras share one round definition (<round>, defined in the Canal Era and referenced by the Rail Era).

description.zh: 整局伯明翰游戏，作为最外层轮：设置、运河时代、铁路时代与终局计分。
description.en: The whole game of Brass: Birmingham as the outermost round: setup, the Canal Era, the Rail Era, and final scoring.

description.zh: 游戏设置：版图、商人板块与商人啤酒、煤/铁市场、万能卡区、抽牌堆（按人数移除地点卡）、银行、角色板块随机顺序，以及每名玩家的链接板块、工业板块堆、£17、标记与起始手牌（8 张 + 1 张面朝下弃牌底卡）。
description.en: Game setup: the board, merchant tiles and merchant beer, the coal/iron markets, the wild-card areas, the draw deck (location cards removed by player count), the bank, the random character-tile order, and each player's link tiles, industry tile stacks, £17, markers, and starting hand (8 cards + 1 face-down discard bottom).

description.zh: 把<board>放到桌面中央。
description.en: Place the <board> in the middle of the table.

description.zh: 把 78 张<merchant_tile>洗混，正面朝上放在标记不超过本局人数的<merchant_space>上（2 人局只用 2+ 空位、3 人局 2+/3+、4 人局全部）。
description.en: Shuffle the 78 <merchant_tile>s and place them face up on <merchant_space>s whose mark does not exceed the player count (2-player games use only 2+ spaces, 3-player games 2+/3+, 4-player games all).

quantity.zh: 标记与玩家数相符的商人空位数。
quantity.en: The number of merchant spaces matching the player count.

description.zh: 从<ontology::game_box>取<beer_barrel>，在每个非空白<merchant_tile>旁的<merchant_beer_space>放 1 桶。
description.en: Take <beer_barrel>s from the <ontology::game_box> and place 1 on each <merchant_beer_space> beside a non-blank <merchant_tile>.

quantity.zh: 每个非空白商人板块旁 1 桶。

description.zh: 用<coal>填满<coal_market>的槽位——**只留 1 个 £1 槽为空**。
description.en: Fill the <coal_market>'s slots with <coal> — **leaving only one £1 slot empty**.

quantity.zh: 除 1 个 £1 槽外的全部槽位。

description.zh: 用<iron>填满<iron_market>的槽位——**只留 2 个 £1 槽为空**。
description.en: Fill the <iron_market>'s slots with <iron> — **leaving only two £1 slots empty**.

quantity.zh: 除 2 个 £1 槽外的全部槽位。

description.zh: 把 2 张<wild_location_card>正面朝上放到第 1 个<card_draw_area>。
description.en: Place the 2 <wild_location_card>s face up on the first <card_draw_area>.

description.zh: 把 2 张<wild_industry_card>正面朝上放到第 2 个<card_draw_area>。
description.en: Place the 2 <wild_industry_card>s face up on the second <card_draw_area>.

description.zh: 先按人数移除<location_card>：2 人局移除蓝色与青色横幅地点的全部地点卡、3 人局仅移除青色（万能卡不进抽牌堆）。把剩余的<location_card>与<industry_card>洗混，面朝下放到第 3 个<card_draw_area>作为<draw_deck>。
description.en: First remove <location_card>s by player count: in a 2-player game remove all cards of blue- and teal-banner locations; in a 3-player game only teal (wild cards never enter the deck). Shuffle the remaining <location_card>s and <industry_card>s and place them face down on the third <card_draw_area> as the <draw_deck>.

description.zh: 把所有<money>（£1/£5/£10/£20 面额）放到<bank>。
description.en: Put all <money> (£1/£5/£10/£20 denominations) into the <bank>.

description.zh: 每名玩家各选 1 张颜色的<character_tile>；把这些角色板块洗混后随机排列在<turn_order_track>上，决定初始回合顺序（轨上从左到右即行动顺序）。
description.en: Each player chooses a colored <character_tile>; shuffle these character tiles and arrange them randomly on the <turn_order_track> to fix the initial turn order (the track reads left to right as the action order).

description.zh: 每名玩家从<ontology::game_box>拿与自己角色板块同色的 20 条<link_tile>放到自己的玩家区。
description.en: Each player takes their 20 <link_tile>s in their character-tile color from the <ontology::game_box> into their player area.

description.zh: 每名玩家把 43 张<industry_tile>按行业分列、从低级到高级（I–VII）堆到<player_mat>对应槽位上，黑顶面朝下。
description.en: Each player stacks their 43 <industry_tile>s by industry, lowest to highest level (I–VII), onto the matching <player_mat> slots, black-top face down.

description.zh: 每名玩家从<bank>拿 £17。
description.en: Each player takes £17 from the <bank>.

description.zh: 每名玩家把 1 枚<vp_marker>放到<vp_track>的 0 位置。
description.en: Each player places their <vp_marker> on the 0 space of the <vp_track>.

description.zh: 每名玩家把 1 枚<income_marker>放到<income_track>的 10 级。
description.en: Each player places their <income_marker> on the 10 space of the <income_track>.

description.zh: 每名玩家从<draw_deck>抽 8 张卡作为<hand>——手牌保密。
description.en: Each player draws 8 cards from the <draw_deck> as their <hand> — kept secret.

description.zh: 每名玩家再从<draw_deck>抽 1 张卡，**面朝下**放到自己的<discard_pile>作为底卡。
description.en: Each player draws 1 more card from the <draw_deck> and places it **face down** onto their <discard_pile> as the bottom card.

description.zh: 运河时代——<current_era>为 canal：每名玩家每个<location>最多 1 个板块（覆盖除外）、酒厂放 1 桶啤酒、只能建<canal_link>（£3、每行动 1 条）。结构：首回合（每玩家仅 1 个行动）→ 主回合循环（每回合末确定下回合顺序＋收收入；**运河最终回合不收收入**）直到<era_end>→ 运河计分 → 时代转换。
description.en: The Canal Era — <current_era> is canal: at most 1 tile per <location> per player (except overbuilds), breweries receive 1 beer, only <canal_link>s are built (£3, 1 per action). Structure: an opening round (only 1 action per player) → main rounds (each ending with turn-order determination + income; **the Canal Era's final round skips income**) until <era_end> → Canal scoring → the era transition.

description.zh: 运河时代的第一回合：从<turn_order_track>首位开始，每名玩家**只执行 1 个行动**（之后的回合才是 2 个）。回合末同样确定下回合顺序并收收入（此时抽牌堆尚满，<era_end>不可能成立）。
description.en: The Canal Era's first round: starting from the front of the <turn_order_track>, each player performs **only 1 action** (later rounds allow 2). The round still ends with turn-order determination and income (the deck is still full, so <era_end> cannot hold yet).

description.zh: 首回合中一名玩家的回合：执行 1 个行动，然后把<hand>补至 8 张。
description.en: One player's turn in the opening round: perform 1 action, then refill the <hand> to 8 cards.

description.zh: 从 7 个行动中选 1 个执行（每个行动弃 1 张卡）。
description.en: Choose and perform 1 of the 7 actions (each action discards 1 card).

name.zh: 补手牌至 8 张（首回合）

description.zh: 从<draw_deck>补牌至 8 张（超 8 张则弃至 8；抽牌堆空则补不满）。
description.en: Draw from the <draw_deck> back to 8 cards (discard down to 8 if above; impossible once the deck is empty).

name.zh: 确定下回合顺序（首回合）

description.zh: 按本回合花钱从少到多重排<turn_order_track>上的<character_tile>（花费相同保持相对次序）；随后把角色板块上的钱收回<bank>。
description.en: Reorder the <character_tile>s on the <turn_order_track> by least money spent this round (ties keep their relative order); then return the money on the tiles to the <bank>.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本回合不是运河时代的最终回合（首回合时<era_end>必不成立，恒真）。
<ontology::condition>.en: This round is not the Canal Era's final round (trivially true in the opening round — <era_end> cannot hold yet).

description.zh: 每名玩家按<income_level>收/付钱：正收入从<bank>拿钱、负收入付给<bank>；付不起时触发<cover_income_shortfall>。
description.en: Each player collects/pays per their <income_level>: positive income takes money from the <bank>, negative income pays the <bank>; if unable to pay, <cover_income_shortfall> triggers.

description.zh: 从第二回合开始重复<round>，直到达成<era_end>（<draw_deck>空 且 所有玩家的<hand>为空）。两个时代共用同一回合定义。
description.en: Repeat <round> from the second round on until <era_end> holds (the <draw_deck> is empty AND every player's <hand> is empty). Both eras share this one round definition.

description.zh: 一回合：从<turn_order_track>首位开始，每名玩家依次执行自己的回合（2 个行动＋补手牌至 8 张）；随后确定下回合顺序（花钱最少者先行）并收收入。此回合结构为运河与铁路两个时代共用。
description.en: One round: starting from the front of the <turn_order_track>, each player takes their turn (2 actions + refill to 8 cards); then turn order is determined (least money spent first) and income is collected. This round structure is shared by both eras.

description.zh: 一名玩家的回合：执行 2 个行动（可相同、每个行动弃 1 张卡），然后把<hand>补至 8 张。
description.en: One player's turn: perform 2 actions (repeatable, each discarding 1 card), then refill the <hand> to 8 cards.

description.zh: 连续选择并执行 2 个行动（每个行动弃 1 张卡，可执行相同行动两次）。
description.en: Choose and perform 2 actions in sequence (each discards 1 card; the same action may be taken twice).

description.zh: 从<draw_deck>补牌至 8 张（超 8 张则弃至 8；抽牌堆空则补不满——这正是时代走向结束的标志）。
description.en: Draw from the <draw_deck> back to 8 cards (discard down to 8 if above; impossible once the deck is empty — the very sign the era is ending).

description.zh: 按本回合花钱从少到多重排<turn_order_track>上的<character_tile>（花费相同保持相对次序）；随后把角色板块上的钱收回<bank>。运河时代最终回合也执行此步——它决定铁路时代的起始顺序。
description.en: Reorder the <character_tile>s on the <turn_order_track> by least money spent this round (ties keep their relative order); then return the money on the tiles to the <bank>. The Canal Era's final round does this too — it fixes the Rail Era's starting order.

<ontology::condition>.zh: 本回合不是运河时代的最终回合——运河时代达成<era_end>的回合不收收入（铁路时代每回合均收）。
<ontology::condition>.en: This round is not the Canal Era's final round — no income is collected in the round where <era_end> holds during the Canal Era (the Rail Era collects every round).

description.zh: 每名玩家按<income_level>收/付钱：正收入从<bank>拿钱、负收入付给<bank>；付不起时触发<cover_income_shortfall>。
description.en: Each player collects/pays per their <income_level>: positive income takes money from the <bank>, negative income pays the <bank>; if unable to pay, <cover_income_shortfall> triggers.

description.zh: 运河时代结束计分：先计所有<canal_link>（每条得两端地点 £ 图标数之和，计分后移除），再计版图上所有翻面<industry_tile>（左下角 VP 之和）。超过 100 分绕圈继续。
description.en: Canal Era end scoring: first all <canal_link>s (each scores the sum of the £ symbols of its two endpoint locations, then is removed), then all flipped <industry_tile>s on the board (sum of their bottom-left VPs). Past 100 VPs the marker starts another loop.

description.zh: 每名玩家自己的每条<canal_link>得 1 分 × 两端相邻地点 £ 图标数之和，<vp_marker>沿<vp_track>推进。
description.en: Each of your <canal_link>s scores 1 VP per £ symbol in its two adjacent locations; advance the <vp_marker> along the <vp_track>.

step.zh: 该玩家全部运河链接的 £ 图标数之和。
step.en: The sum of £ symbols across that player's canal links.

description.zh: 把版图上所有<canal_link>移除，归还各自所有者的玩家区。
description.en: Remove all <canal_link>s from the board and return them to their owners' player areas.

description.zh: 每名玩家把版图上自己所有**翻面**<industry_tile>的左下角 VP 加总，<vp_marker>沿<vp_track>推进。未翻面板块不计分。
description.en: Each player sums the bottom-left VPs of their **flipped** <industry_tile>s on the board and advances their <vp_marker> along the <vp_track>. Unflipped tiles do not score.

step.zh: 该玩家全部翻面板块的 VP 之和。
step.en: The sum of that player's flipped tiles' VPs.

description.zh: 运河时代→铁路时代的转换：移除版图上全部 1 级板块、补满商人啤酒、把所有弃牌洗回抽牌堆、每名玩家抽 8 张新手牌。<current_era>切换为 rail。
description.en: The Canal-to-Rail transition: remove all Level 1 tiles from the board, refill the merchant beer, shuffle all discards into the draw deck, and deal each player a new hand of 8 cards. <current_era> becomes rail.

description.zh: 把版图上**所有 1 级**<industry_tile>（无论是否翻面）移除进盒；其上未用完的<coal>/<iron>/<beer_barrel>回<general_supply>。玩家板上的板块保留。2 级及以上板块留在版图上。
description.en: Remove **all Level 1** <industry_tile>s (flipped or not) from the board to the box; any remaining <coal>/<iron>/<beer_barrel>s on them return to the <general_supply>. Player-mat tiles stay. Level 2+ tiles remain on the board.

quantity.zh: 版图上所有 1 级板块。
quantity.en: All Level 1 tiles on the board.

description.zh: 从<general_supply>取<beer_barrel>，在每个非空白<merchant_tile>旁的空<merchant_beer_space>放 1 桶。
description.en: Take <beer_barrel>s from the <general_supply> and place 1 on each empty <merchant_beer_space> beside a non-blank <merchant_tile>.

quantity.zh: 每个非空白商人板块旁 1 桶。

description.zh: 把所有玩家的<discard_pile>合并（每堆底部的面朝下卡先翻回正面），洗混后放回<draw_deck>区（面朝下）。
description.en: Combine all players' <discard_pile>s (turning the face-down bottom cards over first), shuffle them, and place them face down as the <draw_deck>.

description.zh: 每名玩家从新洗成的<draw_deck>抽 8 张卡作为<hand>。
description.en: Each player draws 8 cards from the newly shuffled <draw_deck> as their <hand>.

description.zh: 铁路时代——<current_era>为 rail：每地点可建多块、酒厂放 2 桶啤酒、只能建<rail_link>（£5/条或 £15 两条＋1 桶酒厂啤酒）、锁图标板块禁建（陶器 1 级除外）。结构：主回合循环（与运河时代共用<round>，每回合均收收入）直到<era_end>→ 铁路计分。注意：MD 的「End of Rail Era」一节重复了运河转换步骤，系规则书勘误——铁路计分后直接进入终局计分，不再转换。
description.en: The Rail Era — <current_era> is rail: multiple tiles per location, breweries receive 2 beers, only <rail_link>s are built (£5 each or £15 for two plus 1 brewery beer), lock-icon tiles are forbidden (except Pottery L1). Structure: main rounds (sharing <round> with the Canal Era, income every round) until <era_end> → Rail scoring. Note: the MD's 'End of Rail Era' section duplicates the Canal transition steps — a rulebook erratum; after Rail scoring the game goes straight to final scoring.

description.zh: 重复运河时代定义的同款<round>（每玩家 2 个行动＋补手牌；回合末确定下回合顺序＋收收入），直到达成<era_end>。铁路时代**最终回合照常收收入**。
description.en: Repeat the same <round> defined in the Canal Era (2 actions per player + refill; round ends with turn-order determination + income) until <era_end> holds. The Rail Era's **final round collects income as usual**.

description.zh: 铁路时代结束计分：先计所有<rail_link>（每条得两端地点 £ 图标数之和，计分后移除），再计版图上所有翻面<industry_tile>（左下角 VP 之和）。超过 100 分绕圈继续。计分后直接进入终局计分。
description.en: Rail Era end scoring: first all <rail_link>s (each scores the sum of the £ symbols of its two endpoint locations, then is removed), then all flipped <industry_tile>s on the board (sum of their bottom-left VPs). Past 100 VPs the marker starts another loop. Final scoring follows directly.

description.zh: 每名玩家自己的每条<rail_link>得 1 分 × 两端相邻地点 £ 图标数之和，<vp_marker>沿<vp_track>推进。
description.en: Each of your <rail_link>s scores 1 VP per £ symbol in its two adjacent locations; advance the <vp_marker> along the <vp_track>.

step.zh: 该玩家全部铁路链接的 £ 图标数之和。
step.en: The sum of £ symbols across that player's rail links.

description.zh: 把版图上所有<rail_link>移除，归还各自所有者的玩家区。
description.en: Remove all <rail_link>s from the board and return them to their owners' player areas.

description.zh: 每名玩家把版图上自己所有**翻面**<industry_tile>的左下角 VP 加总，<vp_marker>沿<vp_track>推进。未翻面板块不计分。
description.en: Each player sums the bottom-left VPs of their **flipped** <industry_tile>s on the board and advances their <vp_marker> along the <vp_track>. Unflipped tiles do not score.

step.zh: 该玩家全部翻面板块的 VP 之和。
step.en: The sum of that player's flipped tiles' VPs.

description.zh: 终局计分阶段：钱兑分（每 £4 得 1 分、上限 15 分）、收入等级 ±分、版图上所有 2 级及以上<industry_tile>的 VP 二次计分，最后按<most_vp_wins>判胜——总分最高者胜，并列先比收入等级再比剩余钱。
description.en: Final scoring: money converts to VPs (1 per £4, max 15), income level adds ±VPs, all Level 2+ <industry_tile>s on the board score their VPs a second time, then <most_vp_wins> adjudicates — highest total wins; ties compare income level, then remaining money.

description.zh: 每名玩家把剩余<money>按每 £4 兑 1 分推进<vp_marker>（向下取整，**上限 15 分**）。
description.en: Each player advances their <vp_marker> by 1 VP per £4 of remaining <money> (rounded down, **max 15 VPs**).

step.zh: 剩余钱 ÷ 4 向下取整（上限 15）。

description.zh: 每名玩家按<income_track>上标记所在等级旁印的 ±分推进或后退<vp_marker>——负收入等级扣分。
description.en: Each player advances or moves back their <vp_marker> by the ±VP printed beside their marker's level on the <income_track> — negative levels lose VPs.

step.zh: 收入等级旁印的 ± 分数。
step.en: The ±VP printed beside the income level.

name.zh: 二级以上板块二次计分

description.zh: 每名玩家把版图上自己**所有 2 级及以上**<industry_tile>（无论是否翻面）的 VP 加总推进<vp_marker>——翻面板块相当于第二次计分。
description.en: Each player sums the VPs of **all their Level 2+** <industry_tile>s on the board (flipped or not) and advances their <vp_marker> — flipped tiles effectively score a second time.

step.zh: 所有 2 级及以上板块的 VP 之和。
step.en: The sum of all Level 2+ tiles' VPs.

description.zh: 判定胜者（FILTER）：总分（<vp_track>上的位置）最高的玩家获胜；如果总分最高的玩家不止一人，则其中收入等级更高者获胜；若仍不止一人，则其中剩余<money>更多者获胜；若仍并列，则共享胜利。
description.en: Adjudicate the winner (FILTER): the player with the highest total (position on the <vp_track>) wins; if more than one player has the highest total, the one among them with the higher income level wins; if still more than one, the one among them with more remaining <money> wins; a final tie shares victory.

description.zh: 总分最高的玩家获胜。
description.en: The player with the highest total wins.

description.zh: 玩家总分（<vp_track>上的位置）最高。
description.en: The player's total VPs (position on the <vp_track>) are the highest.

result.en: The player(s) with the highest total.

description.zh: 如果总分最高的玩家不止一人，则其中收入等级更高者获胜。
description.en: If more than one player has the highest total, the one among them with the higher income level wins.

description.zh: 玩家<income_level>最高。
description.en: The player's <income_level> is the highest.

result.en: The player(s) with the highest income level.

description.zh: 如果收入等级也相同，则其中剩余<money>更多者获胜。
description.en: If the income levels are also tied, the one among them with more remaining <money> wins.

description.zh: 玩家剩余<money>最多。
description.en: The player has the most remaining <money>.

result.en: The player(s) with the most remaining money.
